description: Find Christian churches in the United States by city, state, ZIP code, or a natural-language request (e.g. "churches near me in Frisco TX", "Reformed church in Nashville", "contemporary church with a kids ministry in 92618", "Spanish-speaking church in Houston"). Searches 9,000+ churches across all 50 US states + DC. Filter by denomination (Baptist, Catholic, Non-Denominational, Presbyterian, Anglican, Lutheran, Methodist, Pentecostal, Orthodox…), worship style (Contemporary, Traditional, Liturgical, Blended), kids/youth ministry, size, and theological emphasis. Returns each church's location, denomination, worship style, ministries, Google rating, website, latest sermon video, and statement of faith. If the user says 'near me' without a location, ask for their city or ZIP code first.

hasKidsMinistry.description: Only churches with a children's / family ministry

limit.description: Number of churches to return (default 5, max 25)

query.description: What the user asked, in their own words, e.g. 'family friendly church in Plano TX' or 'Anglican church near 30309'. City, state and ZIP are extracted automatically.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, e.g. 'TX' or 'Texas'

zipCode.description: 5-digit US ZIP code; nearby ZIPs are used if none match exactly

name: find_churches
title: Find churches near a location
